speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound findings of a cystic mass and bile duct dilation combined with your jaundice and weight loss strongly suggest a pancreatic issue, not appendicitis. I need to clarify the nature of that mass: has it been growing, and have you experienced any back pain or new-onset diabetes? REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen with contrast.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Head Adenocarcinoma. Despite the confusing "normal" text in your report, the combination of a subhepatic cystic mass, significant dilation of the bile ducts, and your symptoms of jaundice, pruritus, and pale stools is classic for a malignant obstruction of the common bile duct. This requires immediate surgical evaluation.
